annotations.title: Look up a company in EU business registers

description:
Look up a company in official European business registers by name or registry number.
country: FR (SIREN), NO (org.nr), FI (Y-tunnus), CZ (ICO), PL (KRS number or name; names via GLEIF LEI index + KRS record), EE, SK (ICO or name), BE (enterprise number, BE VAT or name), or any other ISO code / 'LEI' (GLEIF).
Name searches return the exact legal entity first (before branches and similar names).
Returns legal name, ID, status/active, address, VAT ID, activity code and official source link.
Each result has origin (national_register|lei_index|register_snapshot), served_from (upstream|cache), cache_age_seconds,
data_source (legacy: live|cache|register_snapshot), data_as_of and match {type id|exact|fuzzy, score}; a name that only
fuzzy-matches below match_threshold (85) gives status not_found with candidates in near_matches.
GLEIF answers (DE, NL, other countries) carry coverage {scope: lei_holders_only}: companies without an LEI are not covered.
If the upstream register itself rate-limits, status is error with error_code upstream_rate_limited and retry_after (seconds).
Use to confirm a company exists and is active, find its registry number, or map a name to a VAT ID.
Free: basic company search costs 0 units and does not use the free tool-call allowance; it is only rate-limited.

country.description: Register to search: FR, NO, FI, CZ, PL (KRS or name), EE, SK, BE, another ISO country code, or 'LEI' for GLEIF.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 3).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Company name or official registry number (e.g. a French SIREN, Polish KRS, Czech ICO or Belgian enterprise number).
